question: To whom should this Kaula teaching be given and to whom withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching may be given to the worthy
It must not be given indiscriminately
It must not be given to just anyone
inference: This Kaula teaching should be given only to the worthy and not to anyone at all.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, but it must not be given to just anyone.
